title: Judge-C quadruple
description: One judge-training sample: (legal_base, clause_text, verdict, reasoning). Machine self-eval quadruples are tier=bronze (never ground truth); human-annotated pass quadruples are tier=gold. Cross-field rule enforced by the exporter validator, not JSON Schema: verdict=pass is only allowed when provenance.reviewer=human (machine pass is forced to fail).

legal_base.description: Law article or evaluation rule the verdict is grounded in.

source.description: Citation handle, e.g. '民法典 第509条' or 'rubric:sale/v3'.

text.description: Original text fragment of the law article / rule.

section.description: Section heading or path locating the clause in the contract.

verdict.description: Compliance verdict. Machine self-eval pass is forced to fail by the exporter.

reasoning.description: Justification + citations. citation MUST be non-empty (every verdict cites >=1 law/rule).

provenance.description: Annotation lineage. reviewer=human allows verdict=pass; reviewer=machine_self_eval forces verdict=fail.

tier.description: gold = human-annotated (ground truth); bronze = machine self-eval (never ground truth).
